title: Director, Advanced Hardware Manufacturing
text:
Every Zoox vehicle depends on the electronic and sensor hardware our Advanced Hardware Manufacturing team builds and tests. As Director, you will lead the organization that takes this hardware from early builds to serial volume, helping bring safer, cleaner mobility to cities.
Our team values safety first, ownership, and learning together. We solve problems in the open and improve how we work every day. You will be part of the Manufacturing Operations leadership team, reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing Operations. You will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Program Management. This role offers room to grow as our production footprint and team expand.
In this role, you will:
Lead daily operations of advanced hardware assembly and test lines across multiple shifts, delivering on safety, quality, delivery, and cost, and build a culture that puts people and product safety first.
Turn the vehicle demand plan into production and capacity plans covering labor, equipment, shifts, and yield, and lead expansion into new lines and areas with Equipment Engineering and Facilities.
Improve first pass yield and process capability through standardized processes, and partner cross-functionally on root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Manage the Advanced Hardware Laboratories to support R&D across the sensors and compute domains. Lead the build, testing, and pilot production of early-stage prototypes, maturing technical solutions for seamless transition to high-volume manufacturing.
Bring new products and design changes from pilot builds to volume production with Hardware and Test Engineering, giving design-for-manufacturing input early.
Apply lean methods and structured problem solving, and run a data-driven operating rhythm on delivery, cycle time, yield, utilization, and unit cost.
Own operating, capital, and headcount budgets, and deliver cost reduction roadmaps.
Hire, develop, and retain managers, supervisors, line leads, and technicians, with succession and training plans that support multi-shift operations.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
At least 15 years in manufacturing operations for complex electronic or sensor hardware, including at least 8 years leading multi-level production organizations and presenting to executive leadership.
Experience taking hardware products from new product introduction through ramp to serial production.
Results improving safety, quality, delivery, and cost through lean manufacturing and structured problem solving.
Experience owning operating, capital, and headcount budgets, including investments in production lines or facilities.
Bonus Qualifications 
Experience standing up new production lines or facilities in a high-growth environment.
Experience with electronics assembly and automated test, including ESD control and end-of-line test.
Familiarity with manufacturing execution, ERP, and quality management systems, and standards such as ISO 9001 or IATF 16949.

degree.text: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
